summary: Caste-based discrimination in prison systems challenged; violation of Articles 14, 15, 17, 21, 23; segregation of barracks, caste-based manual labor assignments, discriminatory references to denotified tribes/habitual offenders; Model Prison Manual 2016 deemed inadequate; advisory issued by MHA on deletion of discriminatory provisions; court mandates repeal of unconstitutional clauses in state manuals; emphasis on dignity, substantive equality, and constitutional interpretation framework.
final_judgment: Prayer granted; State prison manuals directed to delete unconstitutional provisions; discrimination prohibited; Model Prison Manual updated to reflect constitutional values; MHA advisory on deletion of discriminatory clauses enforced.
